refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `SilikoSyntaxTreeNewError` function creates new `SilikoSyntaxTreeNode` object representing a syntax error.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: `SilikoSyntaxTreeNewError` returns a pointer to a new error `SilikoSyntaxTreeNode` object on success, or `NULL` if there was a memory error.
